title: The Food We Grow
description: 'The Food We Grow' takes you on the story of wheat and how it's grown in different parts of the world, and a glimpse into the history of those parts of the world. It also will inform and educate about the current issues we face in relation to food.
descriptionHtml: 'The Food We Grow' takes you on the story of wheat and how it's grown in different parts of the world, and a glimpse into the history of those parts of the world. It also will inform and educate about the current issues we face in relation to food.

title: Ice and Fire
description: 'Ice and Fire' takes you on the voyage of snow, ice and glaciers and the unique world of Inuits and Nenets living in the coldest regions of the world. Then it takes a u-turn and talks about the fire present inside of the earth which shows up as volcanoes and earthquakes. It will be a voyage worth remembering.

title: Rain & Deserts
description: 'Rain & Deserts' deals with the issue of desertification we are seeing in the world today, and the related concept of rain. It talks about Rain from a new angle, and shows the power of wind. It also tells the unique stories of two very different deserts. This book will open up the reader's mind to the beauty of deserts and the interplay between green land and deserts.

title: Story of Forests
description: 'Story of Forests' is a vital lesson on the importance of forests in our life, retold through the stories of 'Arro', a colorful parrot of the Amazon , the spirit of the Temperate Forests, and 'Teera', the tiger from Sunderbans. It ends with a special story of the city forests. This book is sure to change your perspective about forests.

It ends with a special story of the city forests. This book is sure to change your perspective about forests.

title: Chocolate
description: 'Chocolate' takes you on the journey of 'Horado' a MesoAmerican native who tells you the story of his culture and that of cocoa beans. It then moves on to the sweeping story of 'Akunna', an African who shares his life across two continents and how he achieves freedom finally. On the way, you will discover the history of sugar as it travels across continents. Finally, you will be treated to the story of Gluci, the glucose molecule, it's relation to sugar and it's importance to our body. This book provides stories that you will always be able to relate to when you see chocolate the next time.

title: Rome or Greece?
description: 'Rome or Greece?' takes on the Roman and Greek civilizations from an ordinary man's perspective. The scene starts with a verbal duel between a Greek and Roman; and as they narrate their stories, you will hear about the greats like Socrates, Alexander and Cicero. See if you can decide for yourself which one was the greater?

title: Rise of a Car
description: Have you ever wondered what goes into making a car? Here you will find Jeev going on the same trip trying to build a new car on his own, as he is helped by Sscito. Along the way, you will learn many scientific principles from the ground up, meet legendary inventors and businessmen like Karl Benz and Henry Ford, and discover something new about racing cars!

title: The Puzzle of Progress
description: Are you puzzled by economics and what is the basis of economic decisions taken by a country? Come on this new adventure with Jeev as he goes back in time to the Victorian England and Russia and discovers the philosophies of Karl Marx and Communists. Don't miss his rendezvous with Adam Smith and the surprising story of a modern Indian city!

title: Idea of a Nation
description: 'Idea of a Nation' will pose difficult questions about our identity, and what makes us call ourselves the citizen of any nation. As it discovers the initial surge of nationalism in the 18th century, you will hear from the likes of Voltaire and Rousseau and a common man in France. This book will make you think critically about nationalism and related topics.

title: A Race through the Stars
description: If you have ever wondered about what goes on inside those tiny stars in the sky, this book is going to unravel it all for you. As you explore the stories of 3 unlikely characters in Buzzy, Shiny and Blacky, you will come to know the strange and fantastic ways of how stars live their lives and their relation to this Earth.
